chapter: Later years and the New Orleans scene
title: Hearing Dixieland bands in the French Quarter
summary: Working in New Orleans, Labat visited the French Quarter to hear Sharkey's band, the Dukes of Dixieland and the Famous Door.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene
